Graduate Fees, Financial Support & Awards

Full-time MASc & PhD students are guaranteed a funding package for a set period of registration.

SGS Financial Aid & Advising
Students are encouraged to learn about the financial aid & advising services offered by the School of Graduate Studies.
Teaching Assistantships
All graduate students are eligible to apply for teaching assistantships. Employment as a Teaching Assistant (TA) is a way to earn income and develop both academic & professional skills.
TA job postings can be found on the University of Toronto CUPE 3902 Unit 1 Job Posting Board
Master's students interested in working as a TA are strongly encouraged to apply to postings across the university, as opportunities in CivMin courses may be limited.
Tuition & Fees
Tuition & fee schedules, refund schedules, and other important fee-related matters are published by the University Registrar's Office. When navigating fee information, please note that your academic division is 'School of Graduate Studies'.
Information concerning mandatory and optional non-academic fees can be found on the Office of the Vice-Provost Students website.
Tuition & fees are posted to a student's ACORN account after they are invited to register (typically in mid-July of each year).
Some international MASc and MEng students may be eligible to pay domestic program fees (domestic and international PhD students already pay the same program fees).
Eligibility information can be found on the University Registrar's Office website.
If you have been charged international program fees, but are eligible to pay domestic program fees, you must present proof of status to the School of Graduate Studies. SGS will adjust your tuition accordingly.
Nov. 1 is typically the deadline to update your status for the change to be effective for the Fall Session; Feb. 1 is typically the deadline for the change to be effective for the Winter Session.
PhD students who are in their final year of study will be charged prorated fees based on the date in which they upload their final corrected and approved thesis. Details can be found in the SGS policy on Final-Year Fees.
